ANT-2026-Z477W54M: Unsigned integer underflow in FSG unpacker section loop

An unsigned integer underflow occurs in the section-processing loop of the FSG unpacker.

Target

Project: cisco-talos/clamav
Location: libclamav/pe.c:cli_scanpe (FSG v1.31 unpacker handler, ~line 3719; loop boundt <= (uint32_t)sectcnt - 1underflows when sectcnt == 0)
Discovery: static analysis — not yet dynamically reproduced

Reproduction

This finding was identified by static analysis and has not yet been dynamically reproduced. A trigger input is not included.

[No reproducer or sanitizer output attached — request from security-cvd@anthropic.com if needed.]
